Label: customer support
Definition: Emails requesting help, troubleshooting, or guidance for a product or service. Usually describe issues like login errors, bugs, or malfunctioning features. Common keywords: error, issue, problem, help, access, support, fix, reset, troubleshoot.

Label: finance/billing
Definition: Emails about payments, invoices, refunds, or subscriptions. The sender wants to confirm, dispute, or update financial details. Common keywords: invoice, payment, refund, billing, charge, subscription, renewal, receipt.

Label: high priority
Definition: Urgent or time-sensitive emails about critical issues or outages requiring immediate attention. Common keywords: urgent, ASAP, critical, outage, down, immediate, emergency, escalation.

Label: promotion
Definition: Marketing or sales-focused emails promoting offers, discounts, or new products. Tone is upbeat and persuasive. Common keywords: sale, offer, discount, promotion, new feature, upgrade, limited time, exclusive.

Label: needs human review
Definition: Emails that are unclear, unusual, or don't clearly fit any other category. Also emails that mix several topics, contain legal threats, complaints about staff, or requests for personal or account data, or anything where an automatic reply could be wrong or risky. Do not use this for clear outages or urgent incidents (those are High Priority). When in doubt between this category and another, choose this one.
